title: RapidDataset
description: A Rapid dataset definition: third party data that the user can review and add to OpenStreetMap. The datasetID is the key the definition is stored under. A dataset without a serviceID is loaded by Rapid from its sourceUrl. (This schema is still changing along with the conflation work.)

serviceID.description: The service that provides this dataset's data (e.g. 'mapwithai', 'esri', 'overture'). Omit it for a dataset that Rapid loads from its sourceUrl.

spatialID.description: Identifier for the spatial cache where the data is stored. Defaults to one derived from the serviceID and datasetID.

label.description: Display name for the dataset (used when labelStringID isn't set or can't be localized).

labelStringID.description: Localization string ID for the display name.

description.description: Longer description of the dataset (used when descriptionStringID isn't set or can't be localized).

descriptionStringID.description: Localization string ID for the description.

categories.description: Free-text keywords used to filter the dataset catalog (e.g. 'buildings', 'footways', 'featured', 'preview').

color.description: Display color for this dataset's features, as a CSS hex color (e.g. '#da26d3').

dataUsed.description: Source attribution strings, added to the changeset when features from this dataset are accepted.

extent.description: Bounding extent of the dataset, as [[minLon, minLat], [maxLon, maxLat]].

sourceFileID.description: ID of a file stored in the browser's database. Only meaningful in the browser that stored the file.

itemUrl.description: URL for a page with more information about this dataset.

licenseUrl.description: URL for the license governing use of this dataset.

thumbnailUrl.description: URL for a thumbnail image. Defaults to one chosen from the categories.

beta.description: Whether this is a beta/preview dataset. Defaults to true if categories includes 'preview'.

featured.description: Whether this dataset is featured in the catalog. Defaults to true if categories includes 'featured'.

hidden.description: Whether this dataset is hidden from the catalog (e.g. walkthrough data).

conflated.description: Whether the service already removes features that are mapped in OpenStreetMap (server-side conflation).

conflation.description: Settings for matching this dataset against OpenStreetMap in the browser.

dictionary.description: Data dictionary: how the source attributes become OpenStreetMap tags.

enabled.description: Whether to match this dataset against OpenStreetMap.

showMatched.description: Whether to show features that are already mapped (muted), instead of hiding them.

rules.description: Rules for when a source feature is the same as an OpenStreetMap feature. Any one rule is enough.

conflationRule.description: A rule for when a source feature is the same as an OpenStreetMap feature. Every condition in the rule must hold.

source.description: Which source features this rule tests.

target.description: Which OpenStreetMap features this rule compares them with.

sameKeys.description: Tag keys whose values must be the same on both features.

sameDist.description: Distance in meters within which the features are the same.

sameAngle.description: Largest difference in direction, in degrees, for lines to be the same.

nearDist.description: Distance in meters within which the match needs review. Defaults to sameDist.

nearAngle.description: Largest difference in direction, in degrees, for a match that needs review. Defaults to sameAngle.

geometry.description: The geometry type on this side.

props.description: Property conditions on this side. All must match.

transforms.description: The source attributes, and what happens to each when a feature is accepted. Applied in order.

order.description: The order to apply this transform.

function.description: 'ignore' drops the source attribute, 'copy' copies its value to the target tag, 'constant' sets the target tag to a fixed value (params).

params.description: Parameters for the function (e.g. the value for 'constant').

isID.description: Whether this source attribute identifies the feature.
